svg.title: Bitcoin's curve: a smooth line, and the same equation as scattered dots
svg.desc: Left: the real-number curve y squared equals x cubed plus seven, with two points added by drawing a line through them. Right: the same equation worked modulo 127, which turns the smooth curve into a scatter of 126 dots plus a point at infinity.
svg.text: The curve that guards Bitcoin's keys
What the textbooks draw: a smooth curve
What the computer works with: dots mod 127
